description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing claim expenses within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim expense records, as well as associated validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, listing, and deleting claim expense records, with integrated validation and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all expenses associated with a specific claim request, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new claim expense record, delegating data setting to setClaimExpense() method.

methods.name: setClaimExpense
methods.description: Populates a ClaimExpense entity with request data, performing validation and saving it, within a transaction.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more claim expense records associated with a specified request ID.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single claim expense record based on claim request ID and expense ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing claim expense record, identified by request and expense IDs.
